items.name: base
items.title: MD3 base
items.description: Initialise a project on the MD3 kit: React Aria (aria-nova) stock components, lucide icons, the kit's theme files, the shadcn bridge and utils.

items.name: theme
items.title: MD3 theme
items.description: The kit's theme files (through `tokens`) and the shadcn variable bridge. Writes only the bridge into your CSS (--background: var(--md-sys-color-background), …), never a palette value: import <ui>/ds/tokens/theme.css and theme.v4.css, or your own generated ones, from your entry CSS.

items.name: tokens
items.title: MD3 theme files
items.description: The kit's default theme as files under <ui>/ds/: tokens/theme.css (the 49 Material color roles, light + dark), tokens/theme.v4.css (the Tailwind v4 @theme inline mapping: type, shape, elevation, motion, state layers), tokens/bridge-shadcn.css, the complete tokens/DESIGN.resolved.md, and the kit's neutral DESIGN.md they are generated from. Import theme.css and theme.v4.css from your entry CSS, or the ones generated from your own DESIGN.md.

items.name: design-md
items.title: DESIGN.md generator
items.description: Turns a project's DESIGN.md into its theme and writes the complete file back: tokens/design-md.mjs (the derivation) and tokens/generate-theme.mjs (the command), under <ui>/ds/. Run with `npx tsx <ui>/ds/tokens/generate-theme.mjs DESIGN.md --out theme`; lint with `npx designmd lint DESIGN.md`.

items.name: license
items.title: MIT licence
items.description: The kit's MIT notice, landed next to the copied files at <ui>/ds/LICENSE. Every other item depends on it, so any install carries the licence with the code.

items.name: changed
items.title: Update check
items.description: Lists the kit files a project changed since it installed them, before an update overwrites them: `node <ui>/ds/changed.mjs`. Reads the release record the whole install brings (<ui>/ds/RELEASE.json) and the record each adapter or preset brings (<ui>/ds/releases/); writes nothing, merges nothing. Names the files changed or missing, the optional items left at an earlier release, and prints the update command for what the project holds. Exit 0: none differs. 1: some do, or a file of what the project holds is missing. 2: it cannot tell (no record: a copy installed before 0.3.0).

items.name: preset-editorial
items.title: Editorial preset
items.description: A deliberately un-Material identity for the kit: hand-written 49-role palette, 2px corners instead of pills, a serif face, 1px hairlines instead of elevation shadows, quicker motion and stacked field labels. Import it after tokens/theme.v4.css and put `preset-editorial` on <html>.

items.name: utils
items.title: Kit utils
items.description: twMergeConfig, cn, tv and focusRing bound to the MD3 scales (server-safe).

items.name: render-props
items.title: Render-prop helpers
items.description: composeTailwindRenderProps for React Aria className render props (client-only).

items.name: icons
items.title: Icon contract
items.description: IconComponent / IconProp types, renderIcon, and the kit's built-in SVGs.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Display, Headline, Title, Body and Label primitives on the MD3 type scale, across its two faces (brand for display/headline/title, plain for body/label).

items.name: state-layer
items.title: State layer
items.description: MD3 interaction state overlay (hover 8 %, focus/press 10 %, drag 16 %), whose opacities come from the theme's --md-sys-state-* tokens through the state-opacity-* utilities.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Filled, tonal, outlined, text, elevated and FAB variants.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: Standard, filled, tonal and outlined icon buttons in Material's five sizes, optionally toggleable.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Assist, filter and input chips.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Filled, outlined and elevated cards with CardContent.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Material 3 carousel in its six layouts (multi-browse, uncontained, uncontained multi-aspect ratio, hero, center-aligned hero, full-screen) on React Aria Button and Link: scroll snap, keyline sizing with parallax, reduced-motion fallback, arrow keys.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data table on React Aria Table: sortable columns, optional row selection (checkbox column added), empty state, dense rows, cells cut to one line — M2 data-table measurements on M3 roles.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Static label on a colour-role container (tonal / filled / outlined × neutral / primary / secondary / tertiary / error) — order numbers, plans, statuses. Server-safe.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round person picture with an initials fallback when the image is missing or fails, sized by `size`.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List item
items.description: Material list row with leading/trailing elements (use inside GridList).

items.name: grid-list
items.title: List (GridList)
items.description: React Aria GridList collection with MD3 state layers on items.

items.name: menu-item
items.title: Menu item
items.description: Menu row with icons, supporting text and shortcut.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Popover menu from any trigger, items as data.

items.name: dialog-content
items.title: Dialog content
items.description: Icon, headline, supporting text and actions for a dialog (server-safe).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: React Aria Dialog wrapping DialogContent.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Modal overlay with MD3 enter/exit motion.

items.name: modal-dialog
items.title: Modal dialog
items.description: Dialog inside a modal overlay, driven by isOpen.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: Expand/collapse on React Aria Disclosure: one section, or a DisclosureGroup (the accordion, single or allowsMultipleExpanded). MD3 publishes no page for this component — the anatomy is a 56dp list row with a state layer, outline-variant hairlines and MD3 motion, documented in the doc comment.

items.name: side-sheet
items.title: Side sheet
items.description: Standard (inline) or modal side sheet.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom sheet
items.description: Standard or modal bottom sheet: surface-container-low with extra-large top corners, a drag handle that cycles partial and expanded heights by press, keyboard or drag, and the modal form on React Aria ModalOverlay + Modal + Dialog.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Plain and rich tooltips.

items.name: preview-trigger
items.title: Preview trigger
items.description: A non-modal popover that opens on hover, focus and long press and may hold interactive content — React Aria PreviewTrigger on a Material container surface. MD3 has no page for it; the doc comment says so and points at the rich tooltip for the simpler case.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Material primary and secondary tabs on React Aria Tabs: 48dp rows (64dp with a stacked icon), the 1dp divider, a 3dp rounded indicator that hugs its label for primary and a 2dp full-width one for secondary, fixed or scrollable.

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: One-at-a-time bottom snackbar on React Aria Toast: a global queue and snackbar(text, { action, close, timeout }) helper, auto-dismiss paused on hover / focus, persistent when actionable.

items.name: bottom-navigation
items.title: Bottom navigation
items.description: Material navigation bar: a <nav> of three to five destinations as React Aria links or buttons, with aria-current on the active one and a pill indicator behind its icon.

items.name: top-app-bar
items.title: Top app bar
items.description: Material top app bar in the spec's four baseline types (small, center-aligned, medium, large) with a leading action, a heading title, an optional subtitle and trailing actions. Server-safe. No on-scroll collapse — documented in the doc comment.

items.name: navigation-rail
items.title: Navigation rail
items.description: The vertical destination list of a medium or expanded window, in both spec states: collapsed at 96dp with vertical items and a 56x32 pill indicator, expanded at 220dp with horizontal items in a full-width pill. A <nav> of links or buttons, not a tab set.

items.name: navigation-drawer
items.title: Navigation drawer
items.description: The full-height destination list, standard (inline, elevation 0) and modal (scrim, focus trap, Escape, on React Aria Modal + Dialog). 360dp with 16dp trailing corners, 56dp full-pill active indicators, optional headlines and Divider-separated sections.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or range slider.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Illustration, headline, supporting text and actions.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: The 1dp outline-variant line: full-width, inset (16dp leading) and middle-inset, horizontal or vertical, decorative by default. Server-safe.

items.name: progress-indicator
items.title: Progress indicator
items.description: Linear and circular progress indicators, each determinate or indeterminate, on React Aria ProgressBar — primary active indicator, secondary-container track, a 4dp gap, and a stop indicator on the determinate linear bar. Carries its own keyframe; no animation library.

items.name: loading-indicator
items.title: Loading indicator
items.description: Material 3 Expressive loading indicator on React Aria ProgressBar, always indeterminate: a looping morph through seven Material shapes, default or contained, 24–240dp. Carries its own keyframes; no animation library.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A quantity within a known range (a quota, a disk's use) on React Aria Meter, drawn with the determinate linear progress indicator's anatomy: a colour-role active indicator, secondary-container track, a 4dp gap and a stop indicator. No motion. One of the kit's own: Material 3 does not describe a meter.

items.name: color-area
items.title: Color area
items.description: React Aria ColorArea styled for MD3.

items.name: color-field
items.title: Color field
items.description: Hex input for a color value.

items.name: color-slider
items.title: Color slider
items.description: Single-channel color slider.

items.name: color-swatch
items.title: Color swatch
items.description: Color preview swatch.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color picker
items.description: Swatch trigger opening area, hue slider and hex field.

items.name: field-styles
items.title: Field styles
items.description: The MD3 field container as tailwind-variants slots (filled / outlined, floating label, icons, supporting text) with a kind variant for typed, composite and trigger fields — the one style module behind TextField, NumberField, PhoneField, Select and ComboBox.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field
items.description: Filled and outlined text fields with floating label, icons, supporting text, error and character counter.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: Locale-aware number field: Intl.NumberFormat formatting, min / max / step, arrow-key and wheel stepping, optional trailing − / + steppers.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: Phone field
items.description: Phone number field: E.164 value, as-you-type international formatting and a flag + calling-code country picker in the leading slot (react-phone-number-input on the text-field container).

items.name: image-field
items.title: Image field
items.description: Image upload: drop zone + tonal "Choose image" (React Aria DropZone + FileTrigger), preview with remove icon button and replace, size / type rejection. Value is a data URL.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox and CheckboxGroup with indeterminate, error and disabled states.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: MD3 switch with growing handle and optional icons.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio and RadioGroup with label, supporting text, error and orientation.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Exposed dropdown menu: text-field-shaped trigger with floating label opening a menu of options.

items.name: combo-box
items.title: Combo box
items.description: Autocomplete text field with a menu; selectionMode="multiple" renders the selection as input chips inline with the caret.

items.name: react-hook-form-adapter
items.title: react-hook-form adapter
items.description: FormTextField, FormNumberField, FormPhoneField, FormImageField, FormCheckbox, FormCheckboxGroup, FormSwitch, FormRadioGroup, FormSelect, FormChipGroup and FormComboBox: kit controls bound through Controller. Skip if not on react-hook-form.

items.name: next-adapter
items.title: Next.js adapter
items.description: Router provider for React Aria links and a next/image renderer for Card media. Skip if not on Next.js.

items.name: react-router-adapter
items.title: React Router adapter
items.description: Router provider for React Aria links (Button / Chip / Menu / ListItem href) on React Router; the same shape adapts to TanStack Router. Skip if not on React Router.

items.name: ds
items.title: MD3 kit (everything)
items.description: The one install: every component and primitive with the kit's barrel index, the theme files and the kit's DESIGN.md, the DESIGN.md generator, the ds-theme, ds-build and ds-spec skills for Claude Code, and the update check with the record of this release. Writes nothing into your CSS: the theme, and the shadcn bridge, are files your entry CSS imports.

items.name: spec-skill
items.title: ds-spec skill
items.description: Claude Code skill + script that reads Material 3 specs, Do/Don't guidelines, accessibility and component tokens straight from m3.material.io (no browser, cached per site version).

items.name: theme-skill
items.title: ds-theme skill
items.description: Claude Code skill: give the project a look of its own. Write its DESIGN.md from a brief, generate the theme with the kit's generator, read the warnings, wire the entry CSS, and take a kit update without losing the theme. Carries the DESIGN.md contract the kit reads.

items.name: build-skill
items.title: ds-build skill
items.description: Claude Code skill: build screens with the kit. Role utilities and their pairing, the type primitives, state layers, the resolved DESIGN.md as the reference for values, and what a project may change: an edit of a kit file is allowed, priced and rarely needed.
